name: src-fragger
description: src-fragger — every piece of code the agent writes to complete a task (a sweep script, a migration, a probe, a generator, a harness page, a workflow script: anything that replaces manual, user-involved labor and whose job no single tool call does — an edit, an append, a whole-file write, or one shell command is the tool's own call, never a frag, and a script that does the tool's job because a heredoc failed on the text is the call in costume) is a frag, and a frag is written to the VLDS store's src/ directory, never to a scratchpad or a temp dir. The split is by worth, not by file type: the project's .claude/scratchpad/ is the always-git-ignored notebook — notes, plans, commit messages, logs, captured output, downloads kept for reading; the SessionStart hook seeds a .gitignore of * inside it, so it ignores itself whatever the project's own rules say — and .claude/vlds/src/ is the git-tracked home of every reusable and worthwhile output of that work, code or not (a design page, a sheet or a README lives beside the task's frags, unregistered); a notebook file that turns out to be worth keeping graduates to src/, nothing in the notebook is force-added to git, and a truly throwaway probe may stay there after the gate's ask. The harness's per-session temp scratchpad is never used. The harness scratchpad dies with the session and the notebook lives on one disk; a frag outlives both, so the next task that needs the same labor updates the frag instead of rewriting it, the user can read and edit it (an edit is a ruling), and when the harness refuses the agent's own execution the frag is already where the user can run it. Before any hand-off the agent double-checks: the frag is registered, the refusal is durable (the same call retried unchanged in a fresh tool call — a refusal is bound to the conversation's content, so a fresh call or a fresh conversation can pass where a resume does not), the user's word already covers the act, and the interruption is a decision rather than labor; the retry is recorded in the register. A SessionStart hook injects the contract, seeds the register and the notebook's .gitignore, and says in one line when the project's root rules ignore src/ itself, never editing them; a PreToolUse hook asks before a code file — by extension or by a name such as CMakeLists.txt — is written to a temp location or to any project's .claude/scratchpad/; the store's src/frags.md is the register. Standalone; pairs with vlds by sharing its store.
